share.title: Link and password
share.draftIntro: Sharing starts a {days}-day window. Your client opens the link on their phone and enters the password.
share.draftPoint1: You get a private link and a 9-character password.
share.draftPoint2: Send the link and the password in two separate WhatsApp messages.
share.draftPoint3: The link closes after 7 days, or once the photos have been downloaded twice over.
share.closed: This gallery is closed. Its link no longer works.
share.linkFailed: Couldn't load the link. Close this window and try again.
share.passwordOnce: Copy it now. For your client's safety it is shown only once.
share.lostPassword: The password was shown once when you shared. If it's lost, create a new one.
share.newPasswordBody: The old password stops working immediately. Your client will need the new one to open the gallery.
share.newPasswordFailed: Couldn't create a new password. The old one still works. Try again.
share.closeWarning: The link stops working immediately and the files are deleted within the hour. This can't be undone.
share.closeFailed: Couldn't close the gallery. It is still open. Try again.
share.linkMessage:
Hello! Your photos from {photographer} are ready: {link}
The password comes in the next message.

errors.uploads_in_progress: Wait for all uploads to finish first.
errors.gallery_empty: Add at least one photo first.
errors.generic: Couldn't share the gallery. Check your connection and try again.
